program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define base (cellmap g (r c v) (at g (- h 1) c)))
             (for*/fold ((out base))
                        ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                        (if (= (at g r c) 5)
                            (let ((with-five (set-cell out r c 5)))
                              (if (= (at g (- h 1) c) 2)
                                  (for/fold ((gg with-five))
                                    ((rr (range 0 (min h (+ r 2)))))
                                    (let* ((g1 (if (< rr r) (set-cell gg rr c 0) gg))
                                           (g2 (if (= rr r) (set-cell g1 rr c 5) g1)))
                                      (if (< (+ c 1) w) (set-cell g2 rr (+ c 1) 2) g2)))
                                  with-five))
                            out))))))
